top.h: Find Hidden Bank Fees Before They Drain Your Account

mid.h: Upload Your Bank Statement and Discover Hidden Charges
mid.d: AI scans statements to identify fee patterns and calculate your total annual banking costs.

bot.h: See What Your Bank Is Charging You

top.h: Find Hidden Insurance Charges Before You Overpay

mid.h: Analyze Your Policy for Hidden Fees and Unnecessary Costs
mid.d: AI scans insurance documents to identify charges that increase your premiums without adding value.

bot.h: Discover Insurance Fees You May Be Paying Unnecessarily
bot.d: Upload your insurance documents and see exactly which fees are costing you money.

bot.h: See What Hidden Telecom Fees Are Costing You
bot.d: Upload your latest bill and discover fees you may be able to eliminate or reduce.
